purpose: Separate condition shapes already evidenced by the frozen exact candidate or pinned vanilla SPT 4.1.3 from mechanics that remain unproven before any post-0.1.0 operation is materialized. This inventory narrows future implementation work without changing the frozen 31-quest runtime.

staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: May be reused as the base counter shape for bounded combat operations; target-role/location/equipment refinements remain separately proof-gated.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Frozen Arsenal Fieldwork conditions carry explicit weapon TPL arrays.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: Supports weapon-family objective materialization after the final approved TPL pool is selected.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Frozen Arsenal Munitions conditions use explicit caliber identifiers inside Kills conditions.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: Supports caliber-bounded objectives where the authored operation calls for caliber rather than a named weapon.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Frozen Arsenal Kills conditions serialize the distance comparator object on the exact candidate.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: The structural field is available; any non-zero gameplay threshold still requires pinned vanilla/SPT semantic proof before publication.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Frozen Arsenal chains use target quest ID plus Success status and availableAfter/dispersion fields.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: Supports the already-authored post-0.1.0 campaign graph once operations are materialized.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Frozen quests use compareMethod >= with explicit numeric level values.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: Supports the four authored campaign phases without sales-volume gates.

staticallyProvenShapes.evidence: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 vanilla quest data proves target=Savage with empty savageRole for ordinary Scavs, savageRole=pmcBot for Raiders, savageRole=exUsec for Rogues, and explicit boss aliases such as bossKilla for bosses. Exact evidence is recorded in post-010-role-alias-proof.json.
staticallyProvenShapes.post010Use: Role discrimination may be reused for route-security, labs-security-disruption, rogue-interdiction and boss-oriented operations. Location, extraction, equipment and final boss-set semantics remain separately proof-gated.
